# svg-gauge

- Source: https://github.com/naikus/svg-gauge
- Version source: repository `master`, downloaded 2026-08-28
- Files used: `dist/gauge.min.js` and `LICENSE`
- License: MIT
- Purpose: dependency-free animated SVG meters for the numeric POWER pillars.

The files are vendored so the local CRM does not depend on a CDN or a package manager at runtime.
